description: Curated few-shot seed examples for borderline governance decisions. Shipped with RuriSkry and loaded into AI Search on first startup. As operators accumulate validated real decisions, those will rank above these seeds for their specific environments.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:dev,owner:platform reason=VM deallocated 14 days, no usage signals
examples.outcome_reason: Standard dev cleanup. No DR or compliance tag, no cross-resource refs. Operator agreed.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:test,owner:qa-team reason=VM abandoned after test run 21 days ago, no active alerts
examples.outcome_reason: Abandoned test VM, no dependencies, no incident. Operator agreed.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:staging reason=Staging VM replaced by new image, old one still running, 8 days idle
examples.outcome_reason: Replaced by newer VM, no blast radius. Operator agreed.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=environment:prod,tier:web reason=VM in error state 3 days, no traffic per load balancer logs
examples.outcome_reason: Deletion requires blast radius confirmation — 1 downstream dependent in LB pool. Operator verified no active traffic before proceeding.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=environment:prod,tier:db,owner:data reason=VM shows high memory, propose delete and redeploy
examples.outcome_reason: DB-tier VM in production with active connections — deletion requires CAB review. Operator escalated to team lead.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:api,criticality:high reason=VM CPU spike, propose replacement
examples.outcome_reason: High-criticality API VM, 2 downstream services. Human review required.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=critical production tags=disaster-recovery:true reason=DR VM underutilized, propose cost saving via deletion
examples.outcome_reason: DR-tagged VM — deletion blocked by policy POL-DR-001 regardless of utilization.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=critical production tags=tier:payment,compliance:pci-dss reason=VM CPU at 10%, appears underutilized
examples.outcome_reason: PCI-DSS compliance tag + payment tier — deletion requires compliance review, auto-denied.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:dev reason=Process hung, memory leak detected, restart to restore service
examples.outcome_reason: Dev VM, no downstream dependencies, routine restart. No incident.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:staging reason=Agent connection lost, restart to restore monitoring
examples.outcome_reason: Staging VM with no prod traffic. Safe restart.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:web,scheduled-maintenance:true reason=Scheduled maintenance window restart, OS patches applied
examples.outcome_reason: Scheduled maintenance tag + off-peak window. Operator pre-approved via time-window condition.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:api reason=CPU sustained at 95% for 2h, process appears deadlocked
examples.outcome_reason: Condition: execute during off-hours (00:00-06:00 UTC). Operator confirmed restart at 02:00 UTC.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:payment,owner:finance reason=Payment gateway VM slow, propose restart
examples.outcome_reason: Payment-tier VM — restart requires finance team approval and change window.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:db,replication:primary reason=Primary DB VM high CPU, propose restart
examples.outcome_reason: Primary DB replica — restart causes failover risk. Escalated to DBA team.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=critical production tags=disaster-recovery:true,tier:dr reason=DR VM shows elevated CPU, propose restart
examples.outcome_reason: DR VM restart during active DR posture — denied. Requires explicit DR team approval.

examples.summary_text: action_type=update_config resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:dev reason=Update VM extension config to latest version
examples.outcome_reason: Dev VM, extension update only, no blast radius. Operator agreed.

examples.summary_text: action_type=update_config resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:test reason=Adjust auto-shutdown schedule to new timezone
examples.outcome_reason: Test VM schedule config, no functional impact.

examples.summary_text: action_type=update_config resource_type=microsoft.storage/storageaccounts criticality=non-critical production tags=tier:logs reason=Update lifecycle policy to reduce hot-tier retention from 30d to 7d
examples.outcome_reason: Log storage only, no application dependencies on 30d hot retention. Cost saving approved.

examples.summary_text: action_type=update_config resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=environment:prod reason=Update flow log retention settings on NSG
examples.outcome_reason: NSG config change requires blast radius acknowledgment (3 VMs in scope). Operator confirmed.

examples.summary_text: action_type=update_config resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=compliance:sox,tier:api reason=Update environment variable to point to new secrets endpoint
examples.outcome_reason: SOX-tagged VM — config change requires change advisory board approval.

examples.summary_text: action_type=update_config resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=critical production tags=compliance:hipaa,tier:health reason=Update config to disable audit logging to reduce disk IO
examples.outcome_reason: HIPAA compliance requires audit logging to remain enabled. Config change to disable it is blocked.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=non-production tags=environment:dev direction=restrict reason=Restrict inbound port 22 to specific IP range
examples.outcome_reason: Restricting access (direction=restrict) on dev NSG. No blast radius. Approved.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=tier:web direction=restrict reason=Add deny rule for known malicious IP range
examples.outcome_reason: Restrict rule on prod NSG. Requires blast radius confirmation (2 VMs in scope). Operator confirmed no active traffic from blocked range.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=tier:api direction=open reason=Open port 8080 for new API deployment
examples.outcome_reason: Opening inbound port on prod NSG with 4 downstream VMs — security review required.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=tier:db direction=open reason=Allow new monitoring tool access to DB tier
examples.outcome_reason: DB-tier NSG open — high blast radius (5 VMs governed). Escalated for security team review.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=tier:payment,compliance:pci-dss direction=open reason=Open port 443 inbound from 0.0.0.0/0 for payment processing
examples.outcome_reason: PCI-DSS compliance prohibits unrestricted inbound on payment tier. Denied.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=tier:internal direction=open reason=Temporarily open RDP 3389 for emergency access
examples.outcome_reason: Opening RDP from internet on production NSG is a critical security violation. Denied regardless of justification.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_up resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:dev reason=Dev VM running load test, needs more CPU for test completion
examples.outcome_reason: Dev VM scale up for load testing. Temporary, no prod impact.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_up resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:web,autoscale:true reason=CPU spike to 90% for 30 min, scale up to Standard_D4s_v3
examples.outcome_reason: Web tier with autoscale tag, within capacity budget. No policy violations.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_up resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:db,budget-locked:true reason=DB VM memory pressure, scale up to larger SKU
examples.outcome_reason: Budget-locked tag on DB VM — scale up requires finance team approval for cost change.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_down resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:dev reason=Dev VM over-provisioned, CPU at 5% for 14 days
examples.outcome_reason: Dev VM right-sizing, no active workloads. Cost saving approved.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_down resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-critical production tags=tier:batch reason=Batch VM CPU at 8% for 30 days, peak_cpu_14d=12%
examples.outcome_reason: Batch VM with low historical peak. Scale down approved during off-peak.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_down resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:api,owner:backend reason=API VM CPU at 20% avg, propose downsizing SKU
examples.outcome_reason: Scale down on prod API tier — requires METRIC_THRESHOLD guard: peak_cpu_14d must stay below 50% post-resize.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_down resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:web,peak_cpu_14d:68% reason=Web VM average CPU at 25%, propose scale down
examples.outcome_reason: Peak CPU (68%) exceeds safe scale-down threshold. Escalated to capacity planning team.

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=non-production tags=environment:dev reason=Dev VM process crash, automated restart, SRI near approved boundary
examples.outcome_reason: Just below APPROVED_IF boundary (SRI 18.5). No critical signals, routine restart. Operator agreed.

examples.summary_text: action_type=update_config resource_type=microsoft.storage/storageaccounts criticality=production tags=tier:cdn reason=Update CDN cache TTL from 1h to 24h, SRI at boundary
examples.outcome_reason: Just above APPROVED boundary — CDN config change on prod requires blast radius check (3 origins). Operator confirmed.

examples.summary_text: action_type=scale_down resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:web reason=Right-size web VM, CPU at 15%, SRI near escalated boundary
examples.outcome_reason: Near ESCALATED boundary. METRIC_THRESHOLD condition: peak_cpu_14d must remain under 50%.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=tier:api direction=open reason=Open monitoring port 9090 for Prometheus, SRI at escalated boundary
examples.outcome_reason: Just over ESCALATED boundary. Opening monitoring port on prod NSG — needs security team sign-off.

examples.summary_text: action_type=delete_resource resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=tier:app,backup:enabled reason=VM replacement migration, old VM to be deleted, SRI near denied boundary
examples.outcome_reason: Near DENIED boundary — backup tag present, requires backup verification before delete. Escalated to infra team.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=critical production tags=tier:payment,compliance:pci-dss direction=open reason=Open additional port for payment processor integration, SRI just over denied threshold
examples.outcome_reason: PCI-DSS compliance boundary — NSG open on payment tier blocked. Operator overrode and filed compliance exception (override captured by Phase 35).

examples.summary_text: action_type=restart_service resource_type=microsoft.compute/virtualmachines criticality=production tags=disaster-recovery:true,tier:dr reason=DR VM agent unresponsive, restart for health check
examples.outcome_reason: System initially ESCALATED (SRI 36). Operator force-approved: 'DR resource, no active failover in progress, scheduled maintenance window.' Override captured. Truth: operator's decision correct — no incident.

examples.summary_text: action_type=modify_nsg resource_type=microsoft.network/networksecuritygroups criticality=production tags=tier:ops direction=open reason=Open port 9090 for new monitoring stack replacing legacy tool
examples.outcome_reason: System said DENIED (SRI 64). Operator reduced: 'Monitoring port only, restricted to VPN CIDR, not public internet.' Override noted — effective verdict is ESCALATED with human review. No incident observed.
